title: Job Chapter 36 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Job chapter 36 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Job Chapter 36 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Job Chapter 36.

questions.question: Who is speaking in Job 36?
questions.explanation: Elihu is the one who proceeds to speak and address Job, as stated in Job 36:1.

questions.question: True or False: Elihu claims to have already spoken completely on God's behalf.
questions.explanation: Elihu states that he has yet to speak on God's behalf, indicating he has more to say, as found in Job 36:2.

questions.question: What does Elihu promise to fetch from afar?
questions.explanation: Elihu says he will fetch his knowledge from afar in Job 36:3.

questions.question: True or False: According to Elihu, God's words are false.
questions.explanation: Elihu states that his words shall not be false, asserting the truthfulness of what he speaks, as indicated in Job 36:4.

questions.question: What does Job 36:5 say about God?
options: He is mighty and despiseth not any
questions.correctAnswer: He is mighty and despiseth not any
questions.explanation: Job 36:5 describes God as mighty and not despising any, emphasizing His strength and wisdom.

questions.question: According to Job 36:6, what does God do for the poor?
questions.explanation: Job 36:6 states that God does not preserve the life of the wicked but gives right to the poor.

questions.question: What happens when the righteous are bound in fetters according to Job 36:8?
questions.explanation: Job 36:9 indicates that God shows them their work and transgressions when they are bound.

questions.question: True or False: If the people obey and serve God, they will spend their days in prosperity.
questions.explanation: Job 36:11 states that if they obey and serve Him, they shall spend their days in prosperity and their years in pleasures.

questions.question: In Job 36, what does Elihu warn against regarding judgment?
questions.explanation: Job 36:21 advises to take heed and not regard iniquity, as it indicates a choice between iniquity and affliction.

questions.question: What does Job 36:15 say about God and the poor?
options: He delivers them in their affliction
questions.correctAnswer: He delivers them in their affliction
questions.explanation: Job 36:15 states that God delivers the poor in their affliction and opens their ears in oppression.

questions.question: True or False: God can be fully understood by man according to Job 36:26.
questions.explanation: Job 36:26 asserts that God is great, and we know Him not, indicating that He cannot be fully understood by man.

questions.question: In what manner does God judge the people according to Job 36:31?
questions.explanation: Job 36:31 states that by them He judgeth the people, implying judgment according to their actions.

questions.question: What does Elihu encourage Job to remember about God's work in Job 36:24?
questions.explanation: Job 36:24 encourages Job to remember and magnify the work of God, which is observable to all.

medium.title: Job Chapter 36 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Job Chapter 36 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What will happen to those who do not obey God according to Job 36?
options: They shall perish by the sword
They will be delivered from affliction
questions.correctAnswer: They shall perish by the sword
questions.explanation: Job 36:12 states that those who do not obey God 'shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.' This highlights the consequences of disobedience.

questions.question: According to Job 36, who does God deliver?
questions.explanation: Job 36:15 states, 'He delivereth the poor in his affliction,' emphasizing God's care for those in need.

questions.question: True or False: According to Job 36:14, the hypocrites in heart live long, clean lives.
questions.explanation: Job 36:14 states, 'They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean,' indicating the opposite of living long, clean lives.

questions.question: What does Job 36:18 warn about God's wrath?
options: Beware lest it take you away with his stroke
It is only for the wicked
questions.correctAnswer: Beware lest it take you away with his stroke
questions.explanation: Job 36:18 warns to 'beware lest he take thee away with his stroke,' indicating that God's wrath can lead to severe consequences.

questions.question: How does Job 36:21 instruct the reader to regard iniquity?
questions.explanation: Job 36:21 instructs, 'Take heed, regard not iniquity,' emphasizing the importance of avoiding sin.

questions.question: True or False: Job 36:19 suggests that God values riches and strength above all.
questions.explanation: Job 36:19 states, 'Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength,' indicating that God does not value these things as humans do.

questions.question: What does Job 36:16 say God would have done for Job?
questions.explanation: Job 36:16 states, 'Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place,' indicating God's desire to bring relief.

questions.question: According to Job 36:22, who teaches like God?
questions.explanation: Job 36:22 emphasizes God's unique power and wisdom, stating, 'who teacheth like him?' indicating no one teaches in the same way.

questions.question: What is the consequence mentioned in Job 36:13 for hypocrites?
questions.explanation: Job 36:13 states that 'the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath,' indicating the negative results of hypocrisy.

questions.question: True or False: Job 36:20 advises to desire the night when people are cut off in their place.
questions.explanation: Job 36:20 warns against desiring the night, stating 'Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place,' promoting awareness of consequences.

questions.question: What does Job 36:24 encourage the reader to remember?
questions.explanation: Job 36:24 states, 'Remember that thou magnify his work,' encouraging recognition of God's greatness.

questions.question: What does Job 36:25 say about God's greatness?
options: Only the wise may see it
It is only for the poor
questions.explanation: Job 36:25 states, 'Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off,' indicating that God's greatness is evident to all.

hard.title: Job Chapter 36 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Job Chapter 36.

questions.question: What does Elihu claim he will demonstrate in Job 36:2?
options: He will show that he has yet to speak on God's behalf
He will declare his own righteousness
questions.correctAnswer: He will show that he has yet to speak on God's behalf
questions.explanation: Elihu specifically states, 'Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God's behalf' (Job 36:2).

questions.question: According to Job 36:6, what does God give to the poor?
questions.explanation: The verse states, 'but giveth right to the poor' (Job 36:6), indicating that God upholds justice for those in need.

questions.question: What happens to those who do not obey God according to Job 36:12?
options: They shall perish by the sword
questions.correctAnswer: They shall perish by the sword
questions.explanation: The verse warns, 'But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword' (Job 36:12), highlighting the consequences of disobedience.

questions.question: In Job 36:14, how does Elihu describe the fate of hypocrites?
questions.explanation: Elihu states, 'They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean' (Job 36:14), emphasizing the dire fate of those who are hypocritical.

questions.question: According to Job 36:24, what should people remember to do regarding God's work?
questions.explanation: The verse instructs, 'Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold' (Job 36:24), encouraging acknowledgment of God's greatness.

questions.question: In Job 36:26, what is said about God's greatness?
options: He is great, and we know him not
questions.correctAnswer: He is great, and we know him not
questions.explanation: Elihu proclaims, 'Behold, God is great, and we know him not' (Job 36:26), emphasizing the incomprehensibility of God.

questions.question: What does Job 36:31 say God does by the means of rain?
questions.explanation: The verse states, 'For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance' (Job 36:31), indicating God's role in governance through nature.

questions.question: Job 36:32 mentions God covering the light with clouds. What does this imply about his control?
options: He commands it not to shine
He allows it to shine freely
questions.correctAnswer: He commands it not to shine
questions.explanation: The verse notes, 'and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt' (Job 36:32), illustrating God's sovereignty over creation.

questions.question: True or False: God despises the wicked according to Job 36:5.
questions.explanation: The verse states, 'Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any' (Job 36:5), which is often interpreted to mean God’s disdain for wickedness.

questions.question: True or False: Elihu claims that God can be understood fully by man in Job 36:26.
questions.explanation: Elihu asserts, 'Behold, God is great, and we know him not' (Job 36:26), indicating that God's greatness is beyond human understanding.

questions.question: Which biblical theme does Job 36:10 echo regarding God's discipline?
questions.explanation: Job 36:10 states that God 'openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity,' similar to themes found in passages like 2 Chronicles 7:14 about turning from sin.

questions.question: What literary device is prominently used in Job 36:24-25?
questions.explanation: Job 36:24-25 utilizes parallelism, with the idea of magnifying God's work and the visibility of His creation being closely tied together.

questions.question: What Hebrew word meaning 'to teach' is significant in Job 36:22 regarding God's authority?
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word 'Lamad' means 'to teach' and is significant as it reflects God's role as a teacher of wisdom and righteousness in Job 36:22.

questions.question: Which passage from Proverbs reflects a similar theme of God's judgment as seen in Job 36:31?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:15 states, 'It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity,' paralleling the judgment theme in Job 36:31.

theological.title: Job Chapter 36 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Job Chapter 36 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does Elihu claim he will do in Job 36:2?
options: Show that he speaks on God's behalf
questions.correctAnswer: Show that he speaks on God's behalf
questions.explanation: Elihu states, 'Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God's behalf.' (Job 36:2)

questions.question: In Job 36:5, what attribute of God is emphasized?
questions.explanation: The verse highlights God's might, stating, 'Behold, God is mighty...' (Job 36:5)

questions.question: What does Job 36:6 reveal about God's treatment of the wicked?
options: He preserveth not the life of the wicked
questions.correctAnswer: He preserveth not the life of the wicked
questions.explanation: The verse clearly states, 'He preserveth not the life of the wicked...' (Job 36:6)

questions.question: According to Job 36:10, what does God do to those who are in transgression?
options: He openeth their ear to discipline
questions.correctAnswer: He openeth their ear to discipline
questions.explanation: This verse indicates that God opens their ears to discipline, stating, 'He openeth also their ear to discipline...' (Job 36:10)

questions.question: What is the consequence mentioned in Job 36:12 for those who do not obey God?
options: They shall perish by the sword
questions.correctAnswer: They shall perish by the sword
questions.explanation: The verse states, 'But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword...' (Job 36:12)

questions.question: What does Job 36:15 say about God's action towards the poor?
options: He delivers them in their affliction
He is indifferent to their suffering
questions.correctAnswer: He delivers them in their affliction
questions.explanation: The verse highlights God's compassion, stating, 'He delivereth the poor in his affliction...' (Job 36:15)

questions.question: What does Job 36:22 imply about God's power?
questions.explanation: The verse states, 'Behold, God exalteth by his power...' (Job 36:22), emphasizing His supreme authority.

questions.question: How does Job 36:26 contribute to the understanding of God's greatness?
options: He is small in comparison to man
questions.explanation: The verse states, 'Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.' (Job 36:26)

questions.question: What combined teaching do Job 36:11 and Job 36:12 convey about obedience to God?
options: Obedience leads to prosperity, disobedience leads to death
There is no consequence for disobedience
questions.correctAnswer: Obedience leads to prosperity, disobedience leads to death
questions.explanation: These verses together indicate that obedience results in prosperity (Job 36:11) while disobedience leads to perishing (Job 36:12).

questions.question: In Job 36:30, what does God's spreading of light symbolize?
questions.explanation: The verse states, 'Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it...' (Job 36:30), symbolizing God's omnipotent nature.

questions.question: What does Job 36:19 imply about the value of human wealth in relation to God?
options: It is highly esteemed by God
It is worthless compared to God's power
questions.correctAnswer: It is worthless compared to God's power
questions.explanation: The verse states, 'Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.' (Job 36:19)

questions.question: What does Job 36:8 suggest about the condition of the righteous?
questions.explanation: This verse indicates that even the righteous may face afflictions, as it mentions, 'And if they be bound in fetters...' (Job 36:8).

questions.question: Sceptics claim that God does not intervene in human suffering. What does Job 36:15 teach about God's role in affliction?
options: He delivers the poor in affliction
He does not care about suffering
questions.correctAnswer: He delivers the poor in affliction
questions.explanation: Job 36:15 states, 'He delivereth the poor in his affliction...', highlighting God's intervention and care in times of suffering.

questions.question: How does Job 36:24 encourage the magnification of God's work?
options: It is meant to confuse us
questions.explanation: The verse urges believers to remember to 'magnify his work, which men behold.' (Job 36:24), suggesting it is an important act of worship.

questions.question: What do Job 36:3 and Job 36:4 together affirm about the nature of Elihu's knowledge?
options: It comes from God and is truthful
questions.correctAnswer: It comes from God and is truthful
questions.explanation: Elihu states he will fetch knowledge from afar and that his words will not be false (Job 36:3-4), affirming the divine origin of his understanding.
